subject: Primary Gen7 Core V1 adversarial counterexamples: causal time, cross-gap reversal, stale frame mutation
body: Rescoped per superseding Manager dedupe to independent adversarial falsification of Primary Gen7 Core V1. Recompiled exact Primary artifact source Fold7PresentationHingeGen7.kt SHA256 3f58368e50f0dcb5e871557b6c04df20ca4f05d6e8c73da6fbbaea5b04121c3a and Fold7AttemptOwnerGen7.kt SHA256 255dc3e3a9290087c97017d5e4437e835188f33786b25f3b5f955e7d341a677a. Four deterministic counterexamples reproduced: (1) sourceTimeNs=20ms, deliveryTimeNs=10ms is accepted as trusted; (2) later source with delivery timestamp regressing 100ms -> 50ms is accepted; (3) after 128ms delivery gap, post-gap sample reports reacquiring=true AND reversalDetected=true, and frame mode becomes REVERSAL_GUARD rather than REACQUIRE, so direction continuity crosses the blackout; (4) targetForFrame at 100ms followed by stale callback at 90ms mutates visualProgress 0.074 -> 0.0668 and lastFrame timing, correction=-0.0072000027, rather than rejecting/no-op. These are SOURCE/MODEL counterexamples, not FIELD claims. Additional observation: REACQUIRE -> BLACKOUT_PREDICT speed cap changes 5.5 -> 3.2 progress/s at mode boundary with no acceleration/jerk state; acceptance threshold remains undefined, so classify as review risk rather than defect. No production writes.
